fabrication.finish: ENIG, same finish process for both arms
fabrication.panelization: fabricator-owned panel and singulation subject to DFM acceptance; unit boards are supplied
fabrication.cap_singulation: CNC routing, no V-score, measure finished pad-to-edge clearance

assembly.profile: lab proposes and freezes after pilot; no scored-cap contact fixture
assembly.orientation: cap F.SilkS outward; B.Cu mating down; outer L corner aligns with carrier A1; rotate entire carrier only
assembly.sphere_acceptance: measured diameter minus expanded U >=317.5 um and diameter plus U <=322.5 um

sampling.unit: one cap assembly; twenty joints are dependent
sampling.inference: retain three run effects; no production yield qualification
sampling.remaining_confound: arm remains tied to fixed carrier-site diagonal

measurement.height_reference: opposing finished pad top faces, separately from laminate and mask clearance
measurement.method: calibrated full-volume 3D metrology for whole-cap minima, checked against registered sections
measurement.hot_state: separately quote measured molten plateau gaps; cold geometry cannot qualify liquid equilibrium

model.gravity_sensitivity: literal model only, gravity enabled; no uncorrected fictitious upper-cylinder gravity
model.normal_load: clean bare cap mass including its finish and marking times g divided by 20; exclude solder mass
model.gamma_and_density: required pre-outcome values and sources; no fitted held-out material values
model.model_input_source: incoming metrology and pilot process qualification; no confirmatory height or final-offset inputs
